name: TheDawn

components.pose: Slow, deliberate ascent: she rises upright through the broken ice on a rising pillar of frozen water, arms lowered and slightly out, palms down as if holding the ice steady, chin lifted, gaze to the camera, calm and commanding; full figure from head to toe visible above the ice.
components.headwear: a tall crown of {{METAL}} and clear ice-crystal spires
components.jewelry: a {{METAL}} snowflake collar set with {{GEM}} crystals, long icicle earrings, {{METAL}} cuffs
components.legs_feet: bare feet, a thin glaze of frost beneath them
components.effects: Shards of ice and glittering snow fall back around her in slow arcs, frost spreading outward across the surface of the water, a cold {{MAGIC}} glow in the air and a faint halo of diamond dust.

notes: THE DAWN: the sister rising from the Sundering in her element's homeland - first look at her territory. Her dragon is not yet bound, so no companion; native creatures instead. Rise speed and energy differ per sister.
